t: Time 3183P black flexible cable delivers weather-resistant connectivity for outdoor applications including pond pumps and garden equipment. This 25m drum features 30 x strands per core providing reliable flexibility for outdoor handling and installation, with brown, blue and green/yellow colour-coded insulation for safe earthed connections. The rubber sheath provides enhanced protection against ultraviolet exposure and temperature extremes, whilst the -35 to 60°C operating range ensures consistent performance across seasonal temperature changes and challenging outdoor environments.
b: Suitable for Pond Pumps & Other Outdoor Cabling
